title: HomeLab #1: MikroTik as a Home Router
summary: A comprehensive guide on configuring MikroTik routers for home lab environments, covering network setup, security configurations, and advanced routing features suitable for self-hosting enthusiasts.
problem_solved: Provides a cost-effective solution for home lab enthusiasts who need professional-grade routing, firewall, and network segmentation capabilities without enterprise pricing.
why_valuable: MikroTik hardware offers routerOS's powerful features at consumer prices, making advanced networking accessible for self-hosters and home lab builders to create secure, segmented networks.
